tests.model: norm-preserving reversible nearest-neighbor signal mixing, not physical energy conservation

model: 8 rings of 24 independently seeded complex amplitudes. Two nearest-neighbor orthogonal pair mixing passes with alternating parity; reversible, numerically conserves sum of squared amplitudes. Contact envelope is zero at all 24 anchors. Independent XY/XW and YZ 4D projection retained.
limits: Coupling preserves mathematical signal L² norm, not measured physical energy. A contact is a geometrical shared coordinate, not a force law. Pressure closes displayed geometry but does not dissipate simulated signal; user-selected pause halts exchange. Browser runtime and Pages not yet verified.
